Order No.02 Dated : 04.10.2024 Heard both the sides.

The petitioner- Krishna Adhikari @ Krishna Das Adhikari in connection with Kandra P.S. Case No.
13 of 2023 corresponding to POCSO Case No.12 of 2023 for the offence registered under Section 376 of the I.P.C. and Sections 4 and 6 of POCSO Act pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I cum Special Judge, (POCSO Court), Seraikella.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-I cum Special Judge, (POCSO Court), Seraikella
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Earlier bail petition of this petitioner has been rejected twice by this Court and the petitioner in custody since 14.04.2023.
It is submitted that there is evidence to the effect that relationship was consensual and the victim was not a child at the time of occurrence.
Learned APP submits that issues raised can be considered only at the stage of trial, and not during the hearing of a bail application.
I do not find any change of circumstance for renewal of the bail application.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner, is hereby, rejected.

However, learned trial Court is directed to conclude the trial preferably within six months from the date of communication of this Krishna Adhikari @ Krishna Das Adhikari ... vs The State Of Jharkhand on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111362087/
1 order.
